node.statement: Constant choice and exhaustion of cases: with K_sq=C_ca and a universal positive e_sq no larger than e_ca and e_v (and all smallness radii used below), the nonvanishing-P case follows from node 1.2, while the remaining case has S_P={0} by node 1.1 and is therefore trivial; these cases prove the root contract.
